display.purpose: Full-width hero stamp, stamped in letter by letter through the #ink filter.

title.purpose: Ticket, room-card, plan, course and outcome names; #ink-mid or #ink-soft.

statement.purpose: The manifesto, compressed Archivo whose words light up as the page scrolls.

label.purpose: Uppercase nav, buttons, field labels, footer heads.

shadows.name: plate-glow
shadows.purpose: Button hover, glowing in the button's own colour.

shadows.name: bar-glow
shadows.purpose: Lit hour-bar cells on plan hover.

shadows.name: torch
shadows.value: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(130, 96, 255, .16) 0%, rgba(90, 60, 220, .06) 30%, transparent 62%); mix-blend-mode: screen
shadows.purpose: The fixed UV beam, 70vmax, following the pointer.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Reveals, drawer wipe, hover transitions, arrow nudges.

motion.name: ease-stamp
motion.purpose: Stamp-in: letters and headings drop from scale(1.6) or 1.06 with blur, then a 0.32s thud.

motion.name: beam-follow
motion.purpose: Torch tracking; idle and touch sweep on sine paths.

motion.name: page-transition
motion.value: view-transition: out .35s ease-stamp blur, in .55s ease-out clip wipe

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations .01ms; torch removed; plates fully lit

filters.name: ink
filters.purpose: Heavy ink bleed and pressure blotch for display and headline stamps (displacement 3.2).

filters.name: ink-mid
filters.purpose: Lighter bleed for mid-size stamps so counters stay open (displacement 2.2).

filters.name: ink-soft
filters.purpose: Edge roughening only, for small stamps, wordmark and buttons (displacement 1.6).

narrative.overview:
The site is the dark room at the door of a warehouse party, and the visitor holds the UV torch. Everything is printed in one white stamp ink on a pure black ground, and it turns into the real thing (hot white type, full-colour photographs) only where the light falls. One gesture drives every reveal: the pointer is the torch on desktop; on touch and when idle, the beam sweeps the room by itself.

The material is cheap club print: rubber-stamped condensed display type pushed through an SVG ink-bleed filter, two-tone Bayer-dithered photo prints, dashed perforations, stamp-edged rules, a fixed film-grain overlay. Density is low and loud: huge stamps, long ruled lists, typographic sections instead of card grids. Proof is literal: gear lists in mono, capacities as two-digit figures, membership hour bars whose length is the exact number of hours.

The world refuses the stock club template: full-bleed video, a centred headline, and a grid of cards.
keyCharacteristics: One ink colour for all printed matter; white only where the light lands; red only for booking and live state.
Every photo is a UV plate: dithered ink print on top, colour underneath, revealed by the beam.
Stamped Big Shoulders Black, always through an ink filter.
Square, ruled, perforated: no radius, no cards, no drop shadows.
Motion is a stamp (fast in, thud) or a glow (light passing), never a float.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: All printed matter is Stamp White or one of its two tints. No second hue for type, rules or fills.

rules.name: The Light Means Lit Rule
rules.body: Hot White is a state, not a decoration: it marks what the light (or the pointer, or focus) is on, plus the few elements that are always under the light (hero stamp, ledes, figures).

rules.name: The Door Red Rule
rules.body: Red is booking and live state. If it is not a Book action, a current-page mark, or an error, it is not red.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Every solid Big Shoulders setting goes through an ink filter: `#ink` for display and headline sizes, `#ink-mid` for mid-size stamps so counters stay open, `#ink-soft` for small stamps, the wordmark and buttons. The only unfiltered display setting is the outlined footer wordmark.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only for gear, counts, hours and prices. Never for prose, labels or decoration.

rules.name: The Glow Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow downward. Emphasis is light emitted in the element's own colour.

dos: Do ship every photo as a pair: a two-tone Bayer-dithered ink print and the colour original, combined in a UV plate.
Do route every Book action through the solid Door Red button with the arrow, and keep secondary actions as outline plates.
Do set prices, capacities, hours and gear in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures; capacities as two digits (06, 20).
Do draw quantities at their true length: an hour bar has one cell per hour out of twenty.
Do separate content with 2px rules and dashed perforations instead of boxes.
Do let every reveal be the light: stamp-in (ease cubic-bezier(.7, 0, .84, 0)) for type, a beam or scroll-driven glow for photos and words, and give reduced motion a fully lit, static state.
donts: Don't round corners or put content in cards; the only curves are the ticket notches and the beam.
Don't show a colour photo at rest outside the light; colour appears under the beam or as the beam-borne peek.
Don't use red for anything but booking, current page, and errors.
Don't use drop shadows for elevation; emphasis glows in the element's own colour.
Don't set Big Shoulders solid without an ink filter, or set prose in it.
Don't use Ghost Ink for resting text; it is for rules, borders and the unlit state of a reveal that always completes.
Don't build the stock club template: full-bleed video, a centred headline over it, and a grid of cards.
